content:
The early Amazon Black Friday sale was just updated with a host of new discounts including the lowest prices ever across the Apple Watch Series 12 lineup, now even lower prices on AirPods Pro 3, and the return of the Apple TV 4K discount. You’ll find some deep on smart home upgrades for the holidays and some great ideas for stocking stuffers, intelligent helpers for around the house, and some great Apple gear gifts you can land for less than $20 a pop. For today’s early Black Friday edition of In My Cart, we have put together a collection of the gear we are picking up for ourselves – check it out down below.

Chance

It’s been over a year since AirPods Pro 3 were released, and I love them just as much now as I did on day one. The ANC is fantastic, the sound quality is great, and they’re incredibly comfortable. At their early Black Friday price, they’re even better. I’ve rounded up a couple bonus picks below as well.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249)
  • Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max $29 (Reg. $39)
  • Apple TV 4K (4th generation) $289 (Reg. $299)

Arin

Apple’s latest AirTag 2 in a 4-pack is an easy gift for the whole family and it’s now $79.99 on Amazon (just $20 per tag). I currently rock one with the FineWoven Key Ring. The longer Precision Finding range and louder speaker make it a worthwhile upgrade for those who frequently misplace things.

  • AirTag 2 in a 4-pack $79.99 (Reg. $100)
  • Single AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29)
  • Apple FineWoven Key Ring $25 (Reg. $35)

Ben

Ring doorbells and other home security products are seeing some sizeable discounts this year,with the battery version less than half-price and $100 off the wired 4K model. If you’re in the market for an affordable large screen TV, the Hisense 65-inch U6 Pro is less than half price, with a spec that includes 144Hz, Dolby Vision IQ and Atmos, HDR10+, and an anti-reflective screen. At a rather higher price point, Samsung’s 85-inch The Frame Pro is offering $800 off.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell $39.99 (Reg. $99.99)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $149.99 (Reg. $249.99)
  • Hisense 65″ U6 Pro Series Mini‑LED ULED 4K $529.99 (Reg. $1,099.99)
  • Samsung 85-Inch Class The Frame Pro $2,997.99 (Reg. $3,797.99)

Michael

My picks are products I personally own or recommend as someone deeply invested in the Apple ecosystem. When I travel, anything that helps simplify packing is a win. The Anker Prime 3-in-1 charger is a great example: its compact, foldable design makes it an easy addition to my travel bag, and I can charge my iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods Pro with a single charger instead of packing three separate ones. And with Grand Theft Auto VI arriving this week, the new LG OLED evo C6 is a great way to bring the neon lights of Vice City to life.

  • Apple AirPods Max 2 $449, down from $549
  • Anker 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger $120 (Reg. $150)
  • Apple MagSafe Charger with fast-charging capability $40 (Reg. $50)
  • LEGO Back to the Future DeLorean Time Machine $22 (Reg. $28)
  • LG 65-inch OLED C6 4K TV $1400 (Reg. $2700)

Justin

I have a special someone who will be scoring a new Apple Watch Series 12 in Light Gold this year and with the price now at the lowest ever, it seems the perfect time to strike. I’m very much torn on whether or not I’m going to land the Dark Bronze for myself or not though – I actually really want the new Pearl White Ceramic model, but I’m having a hard time dropping that sort of cash down right now. Beyond that it’s a couple festive Yankee Candles for upcoming get-togethers and some other gear I’m waiting for the Black Friday deals on.

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS $329 (Reg. $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 Ceramic Pearl White $829 (Reg. $899)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard (NEW 2026 model) $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Festive holiday Yankee Candle from $15 (Up to 40% off)

Karthik

I’ve got a few upgrades on my Black Friday wishlist this year, and I’m curious to see just how low their prices will go. The eero 7 two-pack is a strong contender to replace my aging TP-Link Deco mesh Wi-Fi setup, while Samsung’s ViewFinity S8 could finally bring some much-needed resolution bump to my Mac workstation. I’m also eyeing Sony’s Midnight Black PULSE Explore earbuds, which have already hit a new all-time low ahead of Black Friday. And then there’s the Ember Smart Mug 3, which I’d happily swap my older model for, especially now that it’s dishwasher-safe and a lot easier to clean.

  • Eero 7 dual-node mesh Wi-Fi system $230 (Reg. $285)
  • Samsung ViewFinity S8 (S80HF) 27-inch 5K monitor $500 (Reg. $700)
  • Sony Midnight Black Pulse Explore wireless earbuds $119 (Reg. $149)
  • 14-oz Ember Smart Mug 3 for $100 (Reg. $150)

Zac

Three things I already use and would buy again are on my early Black Friday list. My blue UGREEN power bank matches my MacBook Air and iPhone 18 Pro, but the built-in retractable USB-C cable is what makes it so handy for charging an iPad without digging for a cord. A Withings scale is part of my regular routine, and Body Comp is the one I recommend in my smart scale guide. I also use Govee’s TV Backlight 3 at home, where it matches the glow behind the TV to what’s on screen.

  • UGREEN Nexode Pro 25,000mAh 200W power bank (blue)
  • Withings Body Comp smart scale
  • Govee TV Backlight 3 $94 (Reg. $110)

Simon

My early Black Friday picks are all about clever gadgets that make everyday life a little easier. The Fanttik Cafein 11 combines two things I love, coffee and USB-C charging, in a portable espresso maker. For travel, the KeySmart SmartLock adds Find My tracking to a luggage lock, making it a more discreet alternative to tossing an AirTag in your bag. And Anker’s Nano Charger Neo Dynamic takes a similarly clever approach to something as simple as a wall charger, with 180-degree rotating AC prongs that let you point the USB-C port up, down, or straight out from the wall.

  • Fanttik Cafein 11 USB-C Espresso Maker $110 (Reg. $160)
  • KeySmart SmartLock Find My Luggage Lock $20 (Reg. $30)
  • Anker Nano Charger Neo Dynamic USB-C Charger $20 (Reg. $26)

Rein

I’ve been spending the last few years trying to upgrade the home life of my parents after my mom’s spinal disability has severely slowed her pace and my dad has entered his 70s and is naturally unable to do what he used to. To start, there are some LEGO Botanical sets I’m picking up for mom, which she’s been getting into as a way to stay active when immobile, while also upgrading their cleaning routine with Roborock’s 2026 Qrevo S Pro Robot Vacuum and Mop, which is an advanced self-servicing model that keeps down into the accessible price range. From there, the outdated flood light atop their garage needs replacing, which is why I’m picking up the new Anker eufy 4K TrackLight Cam S1, which features a spotlight that tracks suspicious people until away and out of range, though this one isn’t seeing any savings right now.

  • LEGO Botanicals Rocking Plants: $18 (Reg. $23)
  • LEGO Botanicals Mini Orchid: $24 (Reg. $30)
  • LEGO Botanicals Orchid: $40 (Reg. $50)
  • Roborock 2026 New Qrevo S Pro Robot Vacuum and Mop: $400 (Reg. $700)
  • Anker eufy 4K TrackLight Cam S1: $300 (No price cut)
